results.title: The Jesus Tapes
results.overview: Jesus returns to a disturbed, distracted world and is interviewed on a public access TV show.

results.title: Milica Tomić
results.overview: On January 4th 1890, political activist Jaša Tomić murders Miša Dimitrijević, a reporter for the newspaper The Wall (Branik), for publicaly shaming his wife Milica several days prior, recieving a seven year long sentence in the process. Outraged, ashamed and marginalized, Milica, along with her newspaper The Flag (Zastava), decides to clear her name by improving the status and lives of women in the Austro-Hungarian regions of Vojvodina and Banat.

results.title: Oliver, talk to me
results.overview: A portrait of a Sarajevo man.

results.title: Bonded
results.overview: When two sisters return to their childhood home after their elderly parents untimely death, they are forced to confront the disturbing truths hidden in the walls of the house. As their past comes to light, reality begins to distort, threatening to unravel their sanity.

results.title: Noctis Eternal
results.overview: Lucidity doesn't mean much if you can't wake up.

results.title: Little Ghost Laban Goes on Pranking
results.overview: Laban the Little Ghost is back with a new collection of cozy and just-spooky-enough adventures at the Good Morning Sun Castle. Together with his little sister Labolina and his best friend, the Little Prince, their days are filled with everything from trick-or-treating, birthday celebrations, and lost Christmas presents to unexpected guests and many other fun experiences.

results.title: Widows
results.overview: During her husband’s wake, a grieving woman is drawn into a group of widows who tempt her toward a new beginning.

results.title: The End of the Small World
results.overview: The Dog spent peaceful, ordinary days — taking walks in the park, playing games on the computer, and sometimes going to the polling station. If everyone wishes for peace, why do people continue to fight?

results.title: Process
results.overview: Known for his eccentricity and exceptionally long moustache, artist Felix Ambrosious Delacroix the 3rd gets asked about the secret behind his autoportrait. As he explains, it's crucial to begin the work a day before the deadline, on 2 hours of sleep and 12 cups of coffee. But what if the produced artwork still doesn't live up to your expectations? Well, you need to abandon all hope, curl up into a ball and begin... a performance.

results.title: The Encounter
results.overview: What happens in a formerly friendly apartment complex, now on the verge of collapse, when the terrified, isolated residents receive a half-blurred message from an unknown sender? Of course, each of them misinterprets it according to their own desires.

results.title: Julka
results.overview: Julka is a Slovenian-speaking eight-year-old girl who has two friends, Danilo and Marko, with whom she is inseparable. Their lives change drastically when the fascist regime bans the use of local and minority languages and begins a period of persecution and oppression. One day, a teacher hears Julka speaking Slovene in class, so he punishes her and uses violence to enforce his excessive nationalism.

results.title: The Glutton
results.overview: The Glutton eats too much.

results.title: The Double
results.overview: On New Years Eve, Investigator Oleg is asked to check out a case at his own apartment building where he discovers Santa Claus has been looking for him in this mind bending animation.

results.title: Looking for Daddy
results.original_title: Khaili Khaili door va besiar nazdik
results.overview: Ahmad and Fatemeh are a brother and sister who are dreamers and have set out to realize the biggest dream of their lives—a dream that, although considered impossible by everyone else, they want to make come true through the power of their will.

results.title: The law of actions
results.overview: This is the story of Pedro Blanco, a 45-year old unpleasant lonely lumberjack who lives apart from everyone in a dilapidated wooden house in the middle of a virgin forest that is almost completely deforested, and the only mission in this man's life is to cut absolutely all the trees that surround him.

results.title: Chiram
results.overview: Seetha, a young Malayali research student who travels to Visva-Bharati University in Kolkata to study traditional Baul music and culture.

results.title: Totality
results.overview: Twenty-one film crews from Mexico to Canada capture the 2024 total solar eclipse, following several groups of people in preparation for this extraordinary event. This immersive cinematic experience explores this magically cosmic spectacle and the collective human awakening it inspired.

results.title: El último recreo
results.overview: Narciso Ibáñez Serrador's masterpiece, Who Can Kill a Child?, turns fifty this year. This documentary traces its origins, explores the locations where it was filmed, speaks with some of the children who appeared in the film for the very first time, and analyzes its importance in the history of horror filmmaking worldwide. A celebration of the legacy of a film that, five decades later, continues to have the same impact.

results.title: Brother Joseph Again
results.overview: Brother Joseph Again is a rigorous, faith-filled investigation into one of the most fascinating questions in Church history: what did Joseph Smith really look like?

results.title: Melancholy
results.overview: A lonely and depressed young man decides to start beating up delinquents on the streets to cope with his sadness. People call him “Melancholy.”
